facts.summary: FDA full clinical hold over possible liver toxicity · Phase 1/2 · BMF-219 in type 2 and type 1 diabetes · not yet approved

evidence.summary: a full clinical hold has been placed on Biomea's ongoing Phase I/II clinical trials of the Company's investigational covalent menin inhibitor BMF-219 in type 2 and type 1 diabetes
evidence.safety: The FDA cited deficiencies based on the level of possible drug-induced hepatotoxicity observed in the completed Dose Escalation Phase of COVALENT-111.
evidence.program_discontinued: we remain committed to advancing BMF-219 with its potentially transformative profile
